root.label: Larry Nassar removed from Michigan sex offender registry

events.label: Larry Nassar removed from Michigan sex offender registry

slots.name: registry listing status
slots.sentence: And indeed, searches for “Larry Nassar” and “Lawrence Nassar” on the Michigan Sex Offender Registry yield no results.

slots.name: purged individuals
slots.sentence: Nassar is one of more than 20,000 individuals whose names were recently purged from the Michigan State Police database.

slots.name: incarceration status
slots.sentence: Nassar is currently being held at the U.S. Penitentiary Lewisburg in Union County, Pennsylvania.

slots.name: public safety status
slots.sentence: Despite his removal from the registry, there is no threat to the public.

slots.name: registry removals
slots.sentence: Following that ruling, the Michigan State Police scrubbed more than 20,000 offenders whose crimes happened before July 1, 2011, from the online database.

slots.name: age
slots.sentence: Nassar, 63, who is serving several lengthy prison sentences that will last for decades, used his positions at USA Gymnastics and Michigan State University to sexually assault hundreds of athletes.

slots.name: women reporting abuse
slots.sentence: More than 150 women shared their experiences of abuse as part of an award-winning Indy Star/USA TODAY Network investigation series about how Nassar assaulted the athletes he treated for both USA Gymnastics and Michigan State.

slots.name: SORA cutoff date
slots.sentence: While Nassar was not publicly exposed, arrested or convicted until years later, his crimes technically occurred before the 2011 cutoff date.
